messages:
Maya: Quick sync — Caldera AI dedicated pool go-live dress rehearsal Tue 2026-04-05 14:30 UTC. Goals: confirm quota headroom, autoscale ramp, and failover path. Need someone to own burst-policy, someone to run 45m mixed-profile load, and someone to own the renewal note. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated_caldera

Tom: I can do burst-policy + router play. Proposal: burst_capacity=20% over commit for 10m window; enforce per-customer qps cap at 300 rps. Router policy: shift 25% traffic to fallback pool for sustained p95>900ms for 90s.

Raj: I'll run the load (45m). Using the mixed-profile with heavy chat + embeddings blend. Warmup: 12m warm, then ramp to target 240 rps. Will attach k6 script.

Priya: I'll take renewal note & capture enablement checklist. Pre-call agenda: intro(5), SLA review(10), priming demo(15), handover(10). Default renewal_risk -> "low" unless perf issues.

Maya: SLOs for rehearsal: p90 < 500ms, p95 < 900ms, error_rate < 0.8%. If p95 > 1200ms for >120s then invoke fallback and paged oncall.

infra-bot: Calendar event created "Caldera rehearsal" 2026-04-05 14:30 UTC. Link: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/xyz789

Tom: Burst policy snippet:

```yaml
burst_policy:
  extra_percent: 20
  duration_seconds: 600
  preemptible: true
qps_limit: 300
```

Tom: Router fallback CLI (dry run):

```bash
redwood router shift --from=caldera-dedicated --to=caldera-fallback --percent=25 --condition='p95>900:90s'
```

Raj: k6 snippet (minimal):

```javascript
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export let options = { vus: 50, duration: '45m' };
export default function() {
  let payload = JSON.stringify({model:'caldera-8b',input:'<chat>'});
  http.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', payload, {headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY','Content-Type':'application/json'}});
  sleep(0.1);
}
```

Maya: Ops: upload metrics & traces to s3://redwood-caldera/rehearsals/2026-04-05/ with metadata: run_id, operator, script_hash. Tag run run_id=caldera-rehearsal-20260405. Also collect GPU memory headroom metric if available.

Priya: I'll send the feedback form and invite the customer to the walkthrough. I'll also note training needed for their SRE team if autoscaling thresholds change.

Tom: I verified quota_id=cd-332 applied. I also set a prewarmed cache on two nodes.

Raj: I'll post staging results and full k6 report after the dry-run later today.

Maya:+1: Thanks team. Keep this thread for ops notes only; customer comms in meeting.
